table.$description: The table of records: the prose table and every implementation's. The head on the surface in the secondary text color, cells apart by the same padding, and a row that can be chosen raised under the pointer and in the selection color once chosen.

head.$description: The row of column names, on the surface, so it stands out from the rows on the page color.

row.$description: A row of the body: its text, and its fill under the pointer and once chosen. A row at rest has no fill of its own.

cell.$description: The room around the text of every cell, a head's too.
